d:
Fall in love with the romantic vibes of Jala Jala Jalapaatham, the video song from "Uppena". This heartwarming track features Panja Vaisshnav Tej and Krithi Shetty, with mesmerizing music by DSP. Let the melody capture your heart!
Discover this Song on Popular Streaming Platforms.
Song : Jala Jala Jalapaatham
Singers: Jaspreet Jasz & Shreya Ghoshal
Lyrics: Sreemani
Cast: Panja Vaisshnav Tej, Vijay Sethupathi, Krithi Shetty
Written & Directed by: Buchi Babu Sana
Cinematography: Shamdat Sainudeen
